name: Stash v0.9.119
body:
Downloads are many times faster again, and Settings is much easier to find your way around.

## 🎯 What's new

- **Downloads are much faster.** YouTube recently blocked the way Stash fetched songs quickly, so every download was taking about a minute. Stash now uses a way that works, and downloads are many times faster again. Streaming songs from YouTube is quicker too.
- **Opus downloads never get stuck.** A song YouTube only has in AAC used to fail in Opus mode and get retried on every sync. It now downloads in AAC instead.
- **Settings, redone.** Every page is shorter, with one line of text per switch instead of paragraphs. Audio & Quality fits on two screens, and each choice opens a small sheet. Search now finds individual settings, like "equalizer", "dark mode" or "lastfm".
- **Play your own copies first.** If you keep lossless files in Dropbox, OneDrive or Google Drive, Stash can play those before asking Qobuz or Tidal, which saves your daily lossless allowance. Turn it on in **Settings → Audio & Quality → Play my cloud copies first**.
- **YouTube Music Brand Accounts.** If your music lives on a Brand Account, pick it in **Settings → Accounts & Sync → YouTube Music → Profile**, and Stash syncs that library. Stash asks right after you connect if your account has more than one.
- **Fresh mixes on Home.** Made for you and Mood & decades now reshuffle every day (or every 3 days, weekly, or never), and you can favorite a mix to keep it at the front. Long-press a mix to favorite it; the schedule is in **Settings → Appearance → Home layout**.
- **A new artist page.** The artist's photo now fills the top of the page, with play, radio and their links right on it.
- **Community: Play all.** Play or shuffle a whole Community playlist, a song (it keeps going as a radio), or a taste of the top 10 posts. Post pages have big artwork now.
- **Shared links look the part.** Opening a Stash song or playlist link shows its artwork instead of a blank page.

## ✨ UX polish

- A new donate sheet with everyone you can support, including UPI for supporters in India.
- The supporter ticker sits above the logo and moves a little faster.
- Long titles on Now Playing pause a little longer before scrolling.
- Home shows Top albums as a row of covers.
- Tapping a song in recent searches plays it right away.
- The Library filter chips are a bit bigger.
- The Qobuz playlists button now says Search.
- The Cast speaker list scrolls, so you can reach every speaker on a busy network. Thanks Evo for the report.
- **Fetch lyrics** in **Settings → Library & Storage → Library Health** now tries a couple more lyrics sources for songs that still have none, and word-synced lyrics explain more clearly when a lookup didn't work. Thanks Evo.
- Removed the "auto-like on Spotify after a few days" option. Liking a song plus the mirror switch does the same job.

## 🐛 Fixes

- Turning on Last.fm loves no longer shows a warning meant for YouTube Music.
- The Settings home screen counts your cloud storage, Discord and ListenBrainz accounts as connected.

---

## Install

Download `Stash.apk` below and open it on your Android device. If you've got a previous Stash release installed, this upgrades in place — your library, sync history, and settings are preserved.

**Requires:** Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer.

See the [README](https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash#install) for first-time setup.


## What's Changed
* site: privacy page covers saving downloads to Google Drive by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/651
* feat(site): UPI donate button for supporters in India by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/680
* feat(settings): donate sheet with avatars and UPI by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/682
* polish: quick fixes 10-22 + remove Spotify auto-like by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/683
* Artist page: full-width header photo with controls on it by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/685
* Community: Play all / Shuffle, Library-style post pages, fuller song page by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/687
* Shared song and playlist links open on a screen with their artwork by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/688
* Downloads ~10x faster (visionos), and Opus mode falls back to AAC by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/691
* Settings redesign: short pages, one-line copy, search that finds settings by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/684
* Home: reshuffle Made for you / Mood & decades on a schedule; favorite a mix by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/686
* Play your own cloud copy before asking Qobuz or Tidal (#679) by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/689
* YouTube Music: sync a Brand Account profile's library (#664) by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/690
* Cast: the speaker list scrolls (ParaliyzedEvo/Stash#367) by @rawnaldclark in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/692
* Improve on-demand lyrics fetching and word-synced upgrade error handling by @ParaliyzedEvo in https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/pull/681


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rawnaldclark/Stash/compare/v0.9.118...v0.9.119
